RootAdmin._comment: First start creates the root admin. Set RootAdmin:Password (user-secrets or env RootAdmin__Password) to choose its password; if empty a one-time password is generated and shown in the console. RootAdmin:ResetPassword resets a forgotten root password for one start - remove it afterwards.
RootAdmin.Name: Root Administrator

Smtp._comment: Mail server used to send password reset codes. Leave Host empty to only write the code to the server log (local use). Put User/Password in user-secrets.
